description: Candidate source project inventory for the next-generation rendering engine integration effort.

projects.candidate_role: Server-side Chart.js rasterization for reports, thumbnails, and data-visual outputs.
projects.notes: Node canvas-backed Chart.js renderer; useful as a focused chart rendering adapter rather than a full scene engine. Package metadata declares MIT.

projects.candidate_role: Native inspection/reference tooling for Unreal Engine object layouts and SDK generation workflows.
projects.notes: Windows-oriented native tooling; likely unsuitable for direct runtime integration but may inform Unreal asset or metadata extraction paths.

projects.candidate_role: Reference architecture for combining raster and ray/path tracing techniques in a native renderer.
projects.notes: Native rendering research/sample code; evaluate graphics API assumptions, shader portability, and asset pipeline fit before reuse.

projects.candidate_role: Atmospheric scattering and sky rendering reference for physically based environment rendering.
projects.notes: Specialized Unreal-derived sky/atmosphere sample; review Unreal/Epic licensing constraints before adapting algorithms or assets.

projects.candidate_role: Authenticated browser/session automation support for render capture, external preview, or agent-driven QA workflows.
projects.notes: Not a renderer; candidate support service for automated access to web render targets and protected preview surfaces.

projects.candidate_role: Content assembly and publication automation reference for generated render reports or digest outputs.
projects.notes: Use as workflow inspiration only unless a concrete package/build entry point is identified during deeper review.

projects.candidate_role: Full native 3D engine reference for scene graph, renderer architecture, resource management, and samples.
projects.notes: Large native engine with third-party dependencies; evaluate as architecture/reference first before considering vendoring.

projects.candidate_role: DOM node to image capture for browser-rendered components and documentation snapshots.
projects.notes: Client-side DOM/SVG/canvas export utility; candidate for lightweight browser snapshot adapter. Package metadata declares MIT.

projects.candidate_role: HTML-to-video rendering pipeline for animated scenes, demos, and generated media artifacts.
projects.notes: Meta-layer for coding agents that converts HTML outputs into video; package metadata declares Apache-2.0.

projects.candidate_role: Frame-based web rendering or presentation workflow reference for composable generated media.
projects.notes: Monorepo with local AGENTS.md instructions; review internal package boundaries and licensing before reuse.

projects.candidate_role: Markdown preview/rendering reference with math, diagrams, and export-oriented document features.
projects.notes: Package metadata declares NCSA; useful for feature comparison and document-rendering behavior.

projects.candidate_role: Diagram syntax parsing and SVG rendering for flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, and related visuals.
projects.notes: Primary candidate for text-to-diagram rendering; package metadata declares MIT.

projects.candidate_role: SVG/Markdown/PDF/JSON infographic generation reference for stats-driven visual outputs.
projects.notes: GitHub metrics-oriented generator with many plugins; package metadata declares MIT.

projects.candidate_role: High-performance WebGL/WebGPU 2D rendering foundation for interactive canvas scenes and sprites.
projects.notes: Major rendering library candidate; package metadata declares MIT but dependency and asset review is still required.

projects.candidate_role: SSR/build tooling reference for React-based rendering surfaces and universal app packaging.
projects.notes: Use as build-system reference, not a renderer; package metadata did not expose a top-level license in quick inspection.

projects.candidate_role: React integration layer for Three.js scenes, declarative 3D components, and web-native 3D rendering.
projects.notes: Strong candidate for React-based 3D scene adapters; package metadata declares MIT.

projects.candidate_role: Structured document-to-PDF rendering pipeline reference for template-driven professional documents.
projects.notes: Resume/CV renderer; candidate subprocess for document rendering patterns. Project metadata declares MIT.

projects.candidate_role: Domain-specific GestaltView rendering skill pack and operational knowledge base for the engine integration effort.
projects.notes: Internal skill/source corpus for guidance, prompts, manifests, and rendering workflow context; package metadata declares GCL.

projects.candidate_role: Markdown-to-Vue component renderer reference for Vue-based document surfaces.
projects.notes: Candidate only for Vue rendering paths; package metadata declares ISC.

projects.candidate_role: Low-level Vulkan renderer reference or native module candidate for explicit-GPU rendering experiments.
projects.notes: Native Vulkan codebase with examples, tests, benchmarks, and shaders; review platform requirements before integration.

projects.candidate_role: Interactive node graph and flow editor renderer for graph/diagram authoring surfaces.
projects.notes: React/Svelte flow editor monorepo; package metadata declares MIT.
